_meta.description: Source URL whitelist. Hosts listed here are flagged authoritative by the merger even though they are not built-in. Use sparingly — the user has explicitly requested SGX / Yahoo / issuer-IR pages as the only authoritative sources by default.
instructions: To whitelist a new host, add a substring of the host (case-insensitive) to the `allow` array.
Examples: "linkedin.com" would whitelist any URL containing linkedin.com.
Removing a host immediately invalidates any source URL using it on the next merge.
If you add a host here, document the reason in the `notes` array for future maintainers.

notes: listedcompany.com and q4cdn.com are recognised as authoritative directly in merge.mjs (built-in), not here, because they are issuer-IR hosting platforms (SGX/Investis and Q4 Inc respectively) that only ever host the issuer's own filings.
capitaland.com and frasersproperty.com are recognised as built-in authoritative because they are the manager/sponsor corporate domains hosting the REITs' own newsroom PDFs.

cdn.sanity.io/files/rgu3ktoj/ (added 2026-10-26) is Acrophyte Hospitality Trust's own document store: its official site www.acrophytetrust.com serves its results PDFs from this Sanity project. The path is scoped to that project ID, not the whole Sanity CDN.
